debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-i-n-u-t-e-d the c-l-o-s-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n w-i-t-h a f-o-r-m-a-l n-o-t-e s-e-t and l-e-f-t a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-e-s-e-n-t-t-i-m-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) t-h-e p-e-r-s-o-n-a w-a-s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d as a l-o-n-g-d-i-s-t-a-n-c-e r-o-m-a-n-c-e t-y-p-e w-i-t-h-o-u-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a c-h-a-r-a-c-t-e-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e f-o-l-d-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-i-c-e-n-s-e c-h-e-c-k
3) t-h-e m-e-s-s-a-g-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e f-o-c-u-s-e-d on b-u-i-l-d-i-n-g t-r-u-s-t t-h-r-o-u-g-h r-e-p-e-a-t-e-d c-o-n-t-a-c-t and l-e-f-t a c-h-a-t h-i-s-t-o-r-y l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-s-e-n-s-u-s r-e-c-o-r-d
4) t-h-e e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e i-n-v-o-l-v-e-d r-e-c-u-r-r-i-n-g d-e-m-a-n-d-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a p-a-y-m-e-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l n-o-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d r-e-p-o-r-t r-e-v-i-e-w
5) t-h-e m-u-l-e r-e-c-r-u-i-t-m-e-n-t p-l-a-n w-a-s o-u-t-l-i-n-e-d u-s-i-n-g o-p-t-i-o-n-a-l c-o-m-m-a-n-d s and l-e-f-t a t-a-s-k c-l-i-p b-o-a-r-d e-n-t-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l c-o-m-p-l-e-t-i-o-n
